retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast cinematic layout featuring a central figure in formal wear against a bold, oversized graphic numeral background with stacked metallic typography.
excludeWhen: casual or colorful lifestyle imagery is requested
hand-drawn or organic illustration styles are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A sharp, high-contrast composition where a man in a black tuxedo and white shirt stands in a three-quarter profile, holding a small firearm. He is positioned in front of a massive, stylized white numeral '007' that spans the black background. The title is rendered in a stacked, justified block of gold, heavy sans-serif type placed over the subject's torso.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject overlaps the large background graphic to create depth
Gold typography provides a warm focal point against the monochrome palette
Sharp lighting on the subject's face contrasts with the flat graphic background
Vertical stacking of text aligns with the subject's upright posture
coreInvariants: High-contrast black and white background graphic
Metallic gold color for primary display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical axis, medium shot from waist up, slightly off-center to the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright white shirt front.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's eyes down to the firearm, then across to the gold title block, finally following the large background curves.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large blocks of solid black and white in the background graphic create a clean, uncluttered feel.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast between black and white; low saturation except for the metallic gold accents.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy display face paired with a light, spaced-out secondary sans-serif for contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, heavy feel of the display text.
Provides the necessary modern, authoritative weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast image of a man in a black tuxedo holding a handgun, standing against a black background with a massive, stylized white '007' graphic numeral behind him.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a stacked title in heavy gold sans-serif font over the man's torso, and small white metadata text at the bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the background strictly black and white?
Is the main title text gold and stacked?
Is the subject wearing a tuxedo?
Does the large background graphic overlap the subject?

postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast edges between subject and background
Ensure gold text has a metallic sheen
Verify the background graphic is large and bold
Confirm the tuxedo is rendered with clear detail
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject in formal wear + oversized graphic background + stacked metallic sans-serif typography = Cinematic Thriller Aesthetic
